_why: W2 (guild / skyfall / world / chat / arena): names, code strings and dev-only or unreachable UI.

tables.ZONES: names: world region / wild / World Tree place names
tables.WAR_LANE_NAMES: names: Skyfall tower names (Iron Gate, Storm Watch ...)
tables.GUILD_MOTD: unused constant (no reader in the page)
tables.GUILD_SHOP: content shown through GUILD_SHOP_TXT (ewT gshop.* keys) for all 12 entries; name/desc here are fallbacks only
tables.EMBASSY_PERKS: perk names are lookup values; the Embassy panel shows them via embassy2.* keys, descriptions via gshop.perk_*

functions.playerInfoFill: dev/admin tool: player info inside openPlayerAdmin (admin only)
functions.devAdminList: dev/admin tool: online / accounts list (dev panel)
functions.skySimRender: dev tool: God Mode war simulator (AUDIT_MODE = dev account + god)
functions.skySimRun: dev tool: God Mode war simulator run
functions.skySimTower: dev tool: God Mode war simulator tower panel
functions.skySimReplay: dev tool: God Mode war simulator replay (only called from skySimRun)
functions.skySchedOpen: remaining strings are code: n = row ids compared in code (shown via nk keys), Sun..Sat = en-US weekday parse for indexOf
functions.renderGuildWar: reachable part is all t(); the text after the early return is the retired legacy weekly war (audit C9), unreachable
functions.guildWarAttackServer: only called from the unreachable legacy war UI in renderGuildWar (retired, audit C9)
functions.warResetLabel: only called from the unreachable legacy war UI in renderGuildWar (retired, audit C9)
functions.chatName: sender identity fallback sent to the chat server; must stay one stable string
